notes: Batch b50: row D1's anneal wave (plans/algoExploration/d-data-efficiency.md section 6), due since b43 closed 2026-09-22 on the plan's 'worse everywhere' branch. b43a-d's spec verbatim -- b40e-h's M-QR-DQN N 32 cell on the local DQN plumbing (fork 4, shield, PER, target every 8, replay ratio 1, batch 128, lr 1e-5), hist8, fc 320, 3M counted steps, with SNEK_RESET_INTERVAL 600000 gradient steps at alpha 0.5 and no reset after 10.5M -- plus BBF's within-cycle anneal: after every reset n-step restarts at 10 and gamma at 0.97 and both are taken to 3 and 0.997 over the next 10,000 gradient steps (SNEK_RESET_ANNEAL_N_STEP 10,3, SNEK_RESET_ANNEAL_GAMMA 0.97,0.997, SNEK_RESET_ANNEAL_STEPS at its 10,000 default; the first cycle runs from gradient step 0). On the DQN-family path the collector's window, its discount and the env's shaping_discount move together, so a banked transition keeps the gamma^n it was collected under. Why: b43's reset alone never held (600k best30 58-63 and 0 stage-B rows, 2.4M 67-90 and 2 rows, both far under b40e-h), but b43 lacked the piece BBF's own ablations put among the most important in the reset regime -- a freshly reset head relearning from a shorter, more myopic target -- so no b43 result closes D1. Read against b43a-d (the same cell and cadence without the anneal) and b40e-h (no resets) on the hold: the perfect rate after each reset's dip and in the reset-free tail, drawdown count, zero_since; then stage B. Prediction (agent, 2026-09-26): the anneal shortens each reset's dip but does not change the plateau -- the cell recovers to b43a-d's 60-70 within a cycle rather than never, still under b40e-h's 89-93, and no seed reaches stage B. If it holds at or above b40e-h after the resets stop, the reset plus anneal is the late-plasticity lever and the row re-opens on C's best cell.
